playstyle: Capoeira stance mix-ups. Control the mid range with long legs, safe mids and lows, then flow into Handstand (HSP) and Relaxed (RLX) for 50/50s. Wavu warns his combos can be very specific and his counter-hit launches need fast reactions, so drill the routes.

stances.name: Handstand
stances.entry: Many strings (e.g. 1,2) and f,F+4 transition into it
stances.note: HSP.3,3,3 and HSP.4,2 tornado; HSP.3,3,3 then flows into RLX.

stances.name: Relaxed
stances.note: RLX.2 is -2 on block and a combo filler; RLX.4,3 is a Heat Engager; RLX.3+4 tornadoes.
